items.risk: Q2 GAAP gross margin was boosted by $45.4M of prior-period tariff refunds; non-GAAP gross margin of 46.8% is more representative of ongoing economics.
Q2 revenue remained materially below Q2 2025, and U.S. revenue declined about 3% sequentially.
Safe-harbor revenue, tax-credit mechanics and tariff refunds can obscure normalized demand and margin trends if not separated.
Core residential solar/storage demand is policy-, financing- and regional-demand sensitive; platform relevance does not establish irreplaceable bottleneck control.
The IQ SST adjacency is pre-commercial in current evidence, so it should not carry causal weight equivalent to demonstrated solar/storage revenue.
Government incentives, safe-harbor mechanics, tariff refunds and trade policy can materially change reported revenue/margins and customer economics.
Residential inverter/storage markets have credible substitutes; differentiation can erode through price competition, integrated alternatives or regional demand weakness.
Treating IQ SST RFI/RFP activity as backlog or contracted demand would inflate confidence; current evidence supports pipeline only.

A full-system IQ SST demonstration is planned later in 2026; commercial proof remains outstanding.
Commercial IQ SST conversion, unit economics and customer concentration are unproven.
Current normalized gross margin absent tariff refunds/incentive effects and future policy mix remains uncertain.
